# Third-party / generated assets

## Assets/Resources/Characters/Mannequin.fbx
- Stand-in humanoid mannequin (skinned mesh, 21-bone Unity-humanoid-named skeleton) with clips Idle, Walk, Run, Attack, Death.
- Source: generated procedurally for Oathmarch by `Assets/Tools/make_mannequin.py` with Blender 4.2.3 LTS (headless). No third-party mesh or animation data.
- License: CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication). Free to use, modify, ship.
- Why not Kenney/Quaternius: their CC0 packs are only offered behind JS download pages that could not be fetched from the build box. Swapping them in later is a drop-in (see README).

No other third-party assets are included. All environment art is runtime greybox primitives.
